restaurant_name: เอิบสิน คลินิก (DRT)
text: I have been to see Dr Thiti since I was a young boy. Now I am in my mid 30s. Excellent dentist with gentle manners. Polite, careful & caring. Meticulous with his fine dental skills and always gives me enough analgesia before major procedures. He has great communication skills and always puts his patients at ease.

restaurant_name: เอิบสิน คลินิก (DRT)
text: I used to go because the senior dentist, who graduated from a university in the same state as me when I was a child, was kind, meticulous, and attentive. Even as I grew up, I still went to see her because I had seen her since I was a child. But now there's a female dentist, and her work is very shoddy. My fillings don't fit properly when I bite down. She works quickly but carelessly, to the point where I had to get it polished elsewhere. I'm very sad and miss the old senior dentist. I couldn't even get to see her again, so I don't plan on going back. I'm giving it two stars purely based on my childhood memories. Goodbye. I hope you never come back.

restaurant_name: เอิบสิน คลินิก (DRT)
text: The doctor has very soft hands and is very thorough in explaining things in great detail.
